Name: Simple Weatherkeepers
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]Simple Weatherkeepers[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Slate roofs, weathered timber and a valley in bloom.[/size]
[size=5][color=#D8B4FE]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/size][/center]

[size=4]Give familiar places a grand, nature-covered look with seasonal HD building artwork, leafy garlands, flowers and warm window light. Flagstone paving brings the Town roads and bridges together. Choose the artwork you want to use; disabled parts keep the game's original appearance.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]🏡 A decorated valley[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]• HD exteriors for supported Town, outside-Town and farm buildings, with spring, summer, fall and winter artwork.
• Cream walls, slate roofs, timber details and decorative greenery.
• Flagstone paving, matching road edges and bridge decks.
• Optional warm night windows that follow the game's evening light.
• Fish Pond and Shipping Bin keep their vanilla appearance.

This is a building-and-road appearance mod. It does not replace every tree, item, character or interior in the game.[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55051/55051-1793839433-1662801839.png[/img]
[size=4]Seasonal Town buildings and flagstone paving · controlled in-game capture[/size][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#A8DACC]⚙ Choose what changes[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54810]Simple Mod Settings[/url] with GMCM installed. All supported artwork is enabled by default.

• 48 individual building-design choices, plus Town, outside Town and farm group switches.
• Independent switches for paving, curbs, bridge decks and warm night windows.
• One overall switch to restore the original appearance.

Press [b]Alt+1[/b] during free play to open this mod's GMCM settings. The shortcut can be changed or cleared. Save applies your choices; Cancel discards pending edits. Without a settings menu, edit config.json after the mod's first load.

The clinic and Pierre's shop share one design and one switch. Upgraded farm buildings have their own choices. These settings affect the local installation.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]📦 Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1 or newer and Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer on PC. GMCM and Simple Mod Settings are optional; SMS itself requires GMCM.

Extract the [b]SimpleWeatherkeepers[/b] folder into the game's Mods folder and start the game through SMAPI. To remove it, close the game and remove that folder. No save conversion is required.

Use only one Weatherkeepers/world-theme edition at a time. This standalone remains inactive if Simple World Themes or Simple World Presets is loaded.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#A8DACC]ℹ Compatibility and previews[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Built for the supported original-game buildings and map arrangements. Expansion buildings and arbitrary custom maps are not covered. Other visual replacements may overlap; disable the affected design or road section when combining them. Native moving parts may retain the game's pixel artwork.

This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested. Connected multiplayer and full modpack compatibility have not been certified.

Gallery images are actual in-game captures made in controlled private scenes with selected camera positions, seasons and times. Some farm buildings are staged together for review; the images are not evidence of ordinary play or compatibility with every map.

Core settings and farm labels include twelve language banks with English fallback. Named landmarks currently retain English labels.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]✉ Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Please include your game and SMAPI versions, platform, expected and actual result, steps to reproduce, a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url], and a helpful screenshot or video. For suggestions, explain how the change would help you play.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#A8DACC]Credits[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Created and art-directed by [b]xSyy[/b]. Weatherkeepers artwork was made using AI image generation and fitted to the game's building geometry. Original Stardew Valley artwork and game belong to ConcernedApe. Required third-party notices are included in the download.[/size]
